description: A bearded man with dark curly hair, in a white tunic and dark cloak, kneels at a rough wooden table, one hand on his chest and the other resting on an open book. An oil lamp burns beside an inkwell and quills, with rolled scrolls on a shelf to the left. Through an arched stone window behind him is a moonlit garden with palms and olive trees, and the floor is a geometric mosaic.
